copy.tagline: 生成小红书风格的竖版图文卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作小红书风格的竖版图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Generate vertical image cards in Xiaohongshu style
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create vertical image cards in Xiaohongshu style

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 生成小红书或 Instagram 的轮播图文：3:4 竖版，暖色 pastel 背景和虚线 sticker 卡片，含封面、内容页、结尾 CTA。页数随内容调整，短内容至少 7 页，建议不超过 18 页。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作小红书或 Instagram 的轮播图文，或提到“小红书图文”“IG carousel”等关键词时，该技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我做一个小红书轮播，主题是周末野餐攻略，9页3:4，暖色系。
say.note: Claude 会生成 9 页竖版图文。

say.text: 生成一个 Instagram 图文，主题是夏日饮品店，要有封面和结尾 CTA。
say.note: Claude 会按 3:4 竖版排版并添加 CTA。

say.text: 把这份产品介绍做成小红书图文，突出卖点和价格，结尾引导收藏。
say.note: Claude 会自动分页并配暖色 pastel 背景。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude generate a carousel post for Xiaohongshu or Instagram: 3:4 vertical pages with warm pastel backgrounds and dashed sticker cards, including cover, content pages, and ending CTA. Page count adapts to content: at least 7 for short content, suggested max 18.
howto.when_en: This skill is triggered when the user asks to create a Xiaohongshu or Instagram carousel post, or mentions keywords like "Xiaohongshu post" or "IG carousel".

say_en.text: Make a 9-page Xiaohongshu carousel about weekend picnic tips, 3:4, warm colors.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the 9-page vertical post.

say_en.text: Generate an Instagram carousel on summer drinks, 3:4 vertical, cover and CTA.
say_en.note: Claude will format it in 3:4 and add a CTA.

say_en.text: Turn this product intro into a XHS post: highlight selling points, price, end with CTA.
say_en.note: Claude will paginate and apply warm pastel style.
